title: The Last Outlaw

levels.name: Dry Gulch
levels.helperLine: Time to dust off some trouble!
levels.card: Defeat the local bandits and earn your first bounty.

tips.text: J or click = shoot  ·  Shift = sprint
Red barrels blow up - shoot one next to outlaws
Watch the doors! Outlaws pop out, then hide again
W / S = change lane. Bullets only hit in the same lane
Space = jump over bullets
The bandit boss has TWO guns. Drop him and take them!

levels.subtitle: The Beginning
levels.mission: Defeat the local bandits and earn your first bounty.
levels.bossTaunt: You’ll never leave this gulch alive!

levels.name: Muddy Creek
levels.subtitle: The Flooded Settlement
levels.mission: Rescue the villagers and recover the stolen supplies.
levels.helperLine: Hope my boots can handle this mess!
levels.card: Rescue the villagers and recover the stolen supplies.

tips.text: Gold diamonds mark mission targets. Stand in their lane and press E.
Tied-up villagers: run into them to cut them free - they give you tonic or bullets
The gang boss has a SHOTGUN - change lane when he shouts!

levels.bossTaunt: I’ll bury you in the mud, cowboy!
levels.bossDown: Looks like you got washed out!

levels.name: Redstone Canyon
levels.helperLine: Red rocks, bad folks. My kind of day!
levels.card: Cross the canyon and intercept the gold shipment.

tips.text: Gold diamonds mark mission targets. Stand in their lane and press E.
Dynamite! Change lane or get clear before it blows
The gunman has a RIFLE. Take him down and it's yours

levels.subtitle: The Ambush
levels.mission: Cross the canyon and intercept the gold shipment.
levels.bossTaunt: This canyon belongs to me, stranger!
levels.bossDown: Rock bottom looks good on you!

levels.name: Ghost Town
levels.helperLine: Anybody home? Besides the trouble, I mean!
levels.card: Investigate the abandoned town and uncover the gang's operation.

tips.text: Gold diamonds mark mission targets. Stand in their lane and press E.
The lookout carries a shotgun. Watch for the shout!

levels.subtitle: The Forgotten Settlement
levels.mission: Investigate the abandoned town and uncover the gang's operation.
levels.bossTaunt: Boo! Your last ride starts now!
levels.bossDown: Guess you’re the real ghost now!

levels.name: Dead Man's Saloon
levels.subtitle: The Bar Fight
levels.mission: Fight through the saloon and capture the informant.
levels.helperLine: One drink, two fists, zero patience!
levels.card: Fight through the saloon and capture the informant.

tips.text: Whiskey barrels blow up too - use them!
The saloon boss! He has a shotgun - change lane when he shouts

levels.bossTaunt: I’ll make you today’s special, outlaw!

levels.name: Black Gold Mine
levels.subtitle: The Underground Secret
levels.mission: Find the stolen gold and destroy the weapons factory.
levels.helperLine: Digging for gold, finding trouble. Typical!
levels.card: Find the stolen gold and destroy the weapons factory.

villagers.line: They made me dig! Blow it all up!

tips.text: Gold diamonds mark mission targets. Stand in their lane and press E.
Dynamite crates everywhere - one shot sets off the whole row
The factory boss throws DYNAMITE. Beat him and it's yours

levels.bossTaunt: This mine will become your tomb!

levels.name: Iron Horse Express
levels.subtitle: The Train Robbery
levels.mission: Board the moving train and recover the stolen gold.
levels.card: Board the moving train and recover the stolen gold.

villagers.line: The gold is up front with the boss!

tips.text: Gold diamonds mark mission targets. Stand in their lane and press E.
Outlaws jump across the carriages - watch your back lane too
The train boss guards the locomotive - he has a rifle!

levels.bossDown: Your train just missed its stop!

levels.name: Thunder Fort
levels.subtitle: The Military Outpost
levels.mission: Infiltrate the fort and steal the secret documents.
levels.helperLine: Storm’s coming, and I’ve brought lightning!
levels.card: Infiltrate the fort and steal the secret documents.
levels.bossTaunt: My cannons will turn you to dust!

villagers.line: The documents are in the gate tower!

tips.text: Gold diamonds mark mission targets. Stand in their lane and press E.
Powder kegs by the barricades - one shot clears a whole squad
The fort commander holds the gate - shotgun! Change lane when he shouts

levels.name: Cypress Hollow Swamp
levels.subtitle: The Deadly Bayou
levels.mission: Find the gang's ammunition store in the swamp.
levels.helperLine: Smells like trouble. And old socks!
levels.card: Find the gang's ammunition store in the swamp.
levels.bossTaunt: The swamp always swallows its enemies!
levels.bossDown: Guess the swamp spat you out!

villagers.line: The ammo shed is at the end of the boardwalk!

tips.text: Gold diamonds mark mission targets. Stand in their lane and press E.
The gang's ammo is everywhere - shoot the kegs, not just the men
The swamp boss fires two guns at once - keep moving!

levels.name: Frostbite Pass
levels.subtitle: The Frozen Mountains
levels.mission: Cross the mountain and rescue the captured engineer.
levels.helperLine: Cold hands, warm bullets. Let’s ride!
levels.card: Cross the mountain and rescue the captured engineer.
levels.bossTaunt: You’ll freeze before you reach me!
levels.bossDown: Ice cold! Just like your aim!

villagers.line: I'm the engineer! The Warden's at the pass!

tips.text: Snow slows nobody down - keep moving and keep shooting
The Mountain Warden! Change lane when his shotgun glints

levels.name: Moonshadow Fort
levels.subtitle: The Night Infiltration
levels.mission: Free the prisoners and steal the battle plans.
levels.helperLine: Nice moon. Shame about the company!
levels.card: Free the prisoners and steal the battle plans.
levels.bossTaunt: Darkness is my greatest weapon, fool!

tips.text: Gold diamonds mark mission targets. Stand in their lane and press E.
The boss is waiting at the gate!

levels.name: Outlaw's Run
levels.subtitle: The Horseback Chase
levels.mission: Chase the Iron Marshal's convoy before it reaches the capital.
levels.card: Chase the Iron Marshal's convoy before it reaches the capital.
levels.bossTaunt: Nobody outruns the law around here!
levels.bossDown: Looks like you ran out of road!

villagers.line: Thank you! Chase the Iron Marshal's convoy before it reaches the capital.

tips.text: Mounted chase: reach the convoy before time runs out. Shift spurs your horse.
Gold diamonds mark mission targets. Stand in their lane and press E.
The boss is waiting at the gate!

levels.name: Devil's Engine
levels.subtitle: The Steam Wagon
levels.mission: Stop the giant steam-powered war wagon.
levels.helperLine: That engine needs a serious tune-up!
levels.card: Stop the giant steam-powered war wagon.
levels.bossTaunt: My machine will crush your little dreams!

villagers.line: Thank you! Stop the giant steam-powered war wagon.

tips.text: War wagon: dodge marked lanes, then shoot the glowing vent.
Gold diamonds mark mission targets. Stand in their lane and press E.
The boss is waiting at the gate!

levels.name: Blood Red City
levels.subtitle: The Final Territory
levels.mission: Defeat the remaining gang and enter the Iron Marshal's headquarters.
levels.helperLine: Red streets, bad news. Let’s clean up!
levels.card: Defeat the remaining gang and enter the Iron Marshal's headquarters.

villagers.line: Thank you! Defeat the remaining gang

tips.text: The boss is waiting at the gate!

levels.name: The Last Outlaw
levels.subtitle: The Final Showdown
levels.mission: Duel and defeat the Iron Marshal to bring peace to the Wild West.
levels.helperLine: This ends today. I’ve got places to be!
levels.card: Duel and defeat the Iron Marshal to bring peace to the Wild West.
levels.bossTaunt: I am the Iron Marshal. Fear me!

tips.text: Iron Marshal: watch the lane warnings. Jump when every lane is marked.
The boss is waiting at the gate!

endTop: The outlaw gang is finished, once and for all.
story: Hunt the notorious Iron Marshal and bring peace to the Wild West.
